sources.quote: Kepler-560b, also called Kepler-560 Bb, is a confirmed exoplanet orbiting the secondary star of the binary star system Kepler-560.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Kepler-560. Its orbit and size follow Morton et al. 2016's fit, the archive's default.
